sloka: ततो मां संपरिक्षिप्य सर्वतो विकृताननाः ।वधे च ग्रहणे चैव कुर्युर्यत्नं यथाबलम् ।। ५.३०.२३।।।।
transliteration: tato māṁ saṁparikṣipya sarvato vikṛtānanāḥ ।vadhe ca grahaṇe caiva kuryuryatnaṁ yathābalam ।। 5.30.23।।।।

translations.english: "Then all these hideous ogresses will swarm round me and make efforts to capture me with all their strength and kill me.
